observations: Entry points are deployment-defined, not in source: the SPA bootstrap (src/main.tsx) plus each Edge Function's Deno.serve handler. prospector-cron and gmail-sync are additionally invoked by pg_cron / Supabase schedules — an edge the static parser cannot see, so they are NOT marked dead.

Highest call-graph fan-in (shared single points of failure): supabase.ts (32 importers), types.ts (32 importers), utils.ts (25 importers). src/lib/supabase.ts is the mandated single DB client (BR-004), so a change there touches the whole frontend.
Most-written data stores (many-writer hotspots): notifications (5 writer modules), ai_model_usage (4 writer modules), applications (3 writer modules).

application_events is append-only by design (event sourcing, BR-002/BR-003); writes funnel through the transition_stage RPC rather than direct table writes, which is why it shows as a dispatch target, not a multi-writer table.

Confirmed dead code (no runtime inbound edge; imported only by their own tests): calendarIntelligenceService.ts and gmailIntelligenceService.ts (client-side intelligence superseded by server-side gmail-sync) and a second, unwired chat stack (ChatAssistantPanel.tsx + chatAssistantService.ts). Safe-delete candidates.

The Auto-Submission Engine and Gmail Integration are the only domains with real-world side effects (sending applications / sending mail); both depend on Applications Pipeline & Events and are the right blast-radius boundary for the security-hardening phase.
createServiceClient() is copy-pasted across 4 Edge Functions and _shared/http.ts CORS is duplicated in prospector-cron — extraction candidates that would also remove drift risk.

flows.name: A job seeker's roles are discovered automatically
flows.description: Twice a day the system searches for new jobs matching the seeker's profile and files them for review.

steps.label: Scheduler wakes the prospector (pg_cron, twice daily)
Read active search profiles, query SerpAPI, de-duplicate and store new postings
Format each job description for readability
Score job fit and graduate strong matches into the pipeline
Seeker sees new matches on the Prospector dashboard

flows.name: A job seeker approves an application and it is auto-submitted
flows.description: The seeker approves a prepared application; a guarded worker submits it to the employer's ATS.

steps.label: Seeker reviews the prepared packet at the submission gate
Approval is recorded as an immutable event and queued
The kill-default worker drains approved rows (dry-run unless SUBMISSION_LIVE)
Resolve channel and submit via ATS API (or browser fallback)
Notify the seeker of the outcome

flows.name: An incoming email moves an application forward on its own
flows.description: A recruiter email is ingested, classified, and (if confident) advances the application's stage automatically.

steps.label: Scheduled sync pulls new Gmail messages
Classify the email with Gemini (keyword fallback)
If confidence >= 0.70 and the transition is legal, advance the stage

flows.name: A job seeker generates a tailored resume and cover letter
flows.description: From a target job, the seeker generates application documents drafted by the routed LLM.

steps.label: Seeker opens the document builder for a job
Build the request from the master profile + job
Route to the chosen model and draft the document
Sanitize and store the generated document
